meta.name: nano-pdf
meta.description: Edit PDFs with natural-language instructions using the nano-pdf CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自然语言指令编辑PDF文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速用文字指令修改PDF内容
copy.tagline_en: Edit PDF files using natural language commands
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to modify PDFs quickly with text instructions

howto.what: 安装后，你可以用自然语言指令编辑PDF文件中的特定页面，比如修改标题或修正拼写错误。
howto.when: 当你需要修改PDF中的某页内容，并给出文字描述时触发。

say.text: 把deck.pdf第1页的标题改成‘Q3 Results’。
修正deck.pdf第2页副标题中的拼写错误。

howto.what_en: After installation, you can edit specific pages in a PDF using natural-language instructions, such as changing titles or fixing typos.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to modify content on a specific page of a PDF and provide a textual description.

say_en.text: Change the title on page 1 of deck.pdf to 'Q3 Results'.
say_en.note: Claude will invoke nano-pdf to make the change.

say_en.text: Fix the typo in the subtitle on page 2 of deck.pdf.
say_en.note: Claude will identify and correct the typo.
